uncovered_constraints_packaged: R06 is CPU-only: no service, HIP-initializing import, model, DCU/GPU query or use, profiler, trace, PMC, report generator, predecessor skill, or successor skill is run.
The outer scheduler alone creates the formal R06 Goal; the project skill never creates a nested Goal.
Admission requires exactly same-run R01,R02,R03,R04,R05 handoffs in order, one branch/profile/run/lineage, all direct and transitive hashes, complete evidence, and no external runtime ledger.
The fixed dataset and row-zero SHA-256 values are consumed from the sealed selected-request contract; R06 does not search for or synthesize an input.
All eight requests, DP ranks 0 and 1, physical devices 0 and 1, and rank mapping 0-to-0 and 1-to-1 remain explicit in plans, validation, manifests, and handoff.

R01 owns observed denominators, R02 owns process/fragment identities and markers, R03 owns non-replay launch timing/order, R04 owns diagnostic replay attributes only, and R05 owns full-layer attribution/coverage.
All R02 parent and fragment ranges are enumerated and deduplicated before capacity is checked; unresolved, ambiguous, metadata, aliases, and no-kernel states remain visible.
The 9472 parent, 15984 fragment, and 25456 unique counts are regression expectations, never substitutes for current same-run enumeration.
Capacity insufficiency writes only an immutable failure diagnostic, writes no R06 handoff, does not start R07, and permits only audited nondecreasing revision with immutable state/ledger snapshots.

Parameter recovery is found by stable revision ID and diagnostic/before/after/snapshot hashes rather than resume_history[-1], and uses a new formal R06 Goal plus the canonical resume artifact root without rerunning R01-R05.
Visible R07 marker bytes equal R02 transport bytes; forward_id is sidecar-only and every name multiset/hash round-trips independently.
Perfetto, Plotly, and local-viewer probes are isolated, CPU-only, no-network, and preserve available/degraded/unavailable status; missing dotted modules are safely handled.
The R07 target manifest is complete while the R08 hardware plan is bounded; the full family inventory and every selected or excluded family remain visible with evidence consequences.
Hardware plan rows preserve exact kernel literals and defer collector tokens and filter-effectiveness claims until fresh R08 capability evidence.
Every future R08 evidence capture retains the full DP2 mapping even when device/counter passes are serial, and all PMC properties remain replay_projected rather than observed latency.
Artifact-local standard-library tools are frozen and hashed; formal validation has no jq or rg dependency; helper revisions and failed attempts are immutable.
Business artifacts stay below runtime_artifact_root, and exactly one scheduler handoff stays at runtime_handoff_output outside the business manifest.
Execution completion and evidence sufficiency are separate; R07 advances only for complete evidence, full coverage, false next authorization, valid hashes, and a nonempty same-run lineage.
Known large CPU builder/auditor generation requires two consecutive fully stagnant five-minute checks before a scoped scheduler-PID interrupt is considered.
The skill and this Adapt handoff are migration products and do not constitute R06 or performance workflow execution.
